Subject: Region anchoring evidence + erase roadmap (Acme Health)

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. As we discussed, Acme Health needs explicit confirmation for Dedicated: we must ensure our tenant is pinned to a US region (we've requested us-east-2), and that there is no automatic cross-region replication of customer data, backups, or snapshots without our explicit opt-in.

Specifically we're asking for the following artifacts and timelines so we can complete our security review: 
- A short statement on whether backups (snapshots and object backups) are ever replicated cross-region for Dedicated customers by default.
- Retention windows for hot snapshots, incremental backups, and cold archives for dedicated tenants pinned to a region.
- The deletion/erasure workflow for tenant data when we request termination: what objects are removed, how long any backups remain, and what evidence you can provide (audit logs, snapshot hashes/manifests, and an erase certificate).
- Any exceptions (e.g., emergency failover to another region) and the approval path for that to happen.

We'd appreciate a consolidated response and an ETA for an evidence package (we'd like this by next Wednesday if possible). I'm attaching our region requirement doc for reference.

Best,
Morgan Blake
Head of Security Operations | Acme Health
[Attachment: acme_region_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Region anchoring evidence + erase roadmap (Acme Health)

Hi Morgan —

Thanks for the clear checklist and the doc. I've looped in Ben (AM) and Karthik from Ops so we can provide both the contractual/SLAs and the infra evidence. Quick summary up-front: Redwood Dedicated supports explicit region pinning; cross-region replication is NOT enabled by default for dedicated tenants. I'll put the detailed artifacts together and confirm timelines below.

Answers (high level):
- Cross-region replication: OFF by default for Dedicated. We do not replicate snapshots/primary object backups outside the pinned region unless the customer explicitly requests failover/replication as an add-on.
- Retention windows (defaults for Dedicated): hot snapshots: 7 days; incremental object backups: 30 days; cold archive (if enabled): up to 365 days (opt-in). These are configurable per contract; we'll note the values for Acme in the evidence package.
- Deletion workflow: when you request termination we: 1) place the tenant into a pending-delete state; 2) purge live data and tenant-scoped KV caches; 3) expire snapshots and schedule secure deletion of object backups. Backups are flagged for immediate deletion but subject to the retention window (see below); we provide an erase certificate once deletion jobs complete and we can export the deletion audit log and snapshot manifests.
- Emergency failover: possible only with customer authorization or when explicitly triggered by our SRE team under documented incident response with your POA. We will include the approval flow in the package.

ETA: We'll prepare the evidence bundle and draft erase certificate template; target delivery is 5 business days (by 2028-06-06). If you need faster, Ben can escalate.

I'll hand off the infra specifics to Karthik for exact implementation details and artifact examples.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0178

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Region anchoring evidence + erase roadmap (Acme Health)

Hi team —

Adding technical specifics for the evidence package (I'll assemble exports and manifests):

1) Region pinning: Dedicated tenants are pinned at provisioning to the selected region (in this case us-east-2). This affects: compute placement, object storage endpoints, and snapshot storage endpoints. We do not perform control-plane-based live migrations between regions for a pinned tenant.

2) Backups and snapshots:
   - Hot snapshots: point-in-time snapshots of runtime data, retained for 7 days by default. Stored in the customer's region object store (S3-backed equivalent) with AES-256 server-side encryption.
   - Incremental backups: chunked, incremental object backups retained for 30 days (default). These are tenant-scoped and stored in-region.
   - Cold archive (optional): if customer opts into archival export, we write an encrypted archive which can be moved to an archival bucket; cross-region replication for archive is an opt-in managed by procurement and requires an additional ACL/contract.

3) Cross-region replication policy: disabled by default. For Dedicated customers, replication flags are off at provisioning. Any change to enable cross-region replication requires a signed change order and explicit configuration.

4) Deletion/Erasure process:
   - Step A: Initiate termination (Customer or AE ticket). Tenant state moves to "pending-delete".
   - Step B: Orchestrated data purge: tenant database rows are truncated, tenant blobs are queued for deletion, KV caches and ephemeral LRU caches are flushed and tombstoned.
   - Step C: Snapshot lifecycle: existing snapshots are marked for immediate expiry; snapshots with retention beyond the current date are queued for secure deletion. Snapshot manifests and block hashes are retained in our audit export for evidentiary purposes, but the underlying objects are scheduled for cryptographic wipe.
   - Step D: Backup deletion: object backups are deleted from the region store. Deletion jobs are performed by an automated workflow that records object keys, deletion timestamp, actor id, and job status into an immutable audit log (exportable).
   - Step E: Final verification: We run a verification job that attempts to access known keys/objects and returns a deletion report. After verification completes we issue the Erase Certificate.

5) Timelines & guarantees:
   - Live purge: typically completes within 24–72 hours depending on tenant size.
   - Backup/snapshot deletion: adheres to retention windows; we will attempt to purge immediately but we guarantee purging and completion evidence within 30 days of termination for standard Dedicated contracts.
   - Evidence package (what we'll provide): snapshot manifest (hash list), deletion audit log export (CSV), region binding confirmation (provisioning record), and the Erase Certificate (signed PDF).

6) Evidence packaging & delivery: We'll deliver a signed zip over the secure portal (link) and share a short validation checklist you can run locally. For customers requiring an independent attestation (e.g., third-party witness), we can coordinate an SOC2 addendum or an on-prem witness session (requires SOW).

I'll start exporting the manifest and audit logs and will push them to the shared drive link Neha referenced.

—Karthik
Principal Cloud Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference
